lines.japanese: とまあ色々あったものの、アレキサンダーを出てからはまっすぐ風見ヶ丘まで帰ってきた。
lines.english: A great deal had happened, but after leaving Alexander, I came straight home to Kazamigaoka.

lines.japanese: はあ……しかし結局、玉泉日和子には会えなかったな。
lines.english: Sigh... In the end, I never got to see Hiyoko Tamaizumi.

lines.japanese: 俺はしょんぼり背中を丸めながら歩いていた。
lines.english: I walked with my back hunched in disappointment.

lines.japanese: ミニライブは明日だからなあ。彼女所有のチケットは、もう他人の手に渡っちゃった可能性が高い。
lines.english: The mini-concert was tomorrow. There was a good chance her spare ticket had already passed to someone else.

lines.japanese: 仕方ない、当日のキャンセル頼みで行くしかないかなあ。そんなのあるか分からないけど……。
lines.english: No helping it. I would have to go and hope for a same-day cancellation, assuming those even existed...

lines.japanese: はあ、気が滅入る……。
lines.english: Sigh. How depressing...

lines.japanese: 「お兄さん？」
lines.english: “Big Brother?”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: ちょっと沈みかけていたら、聞きなれた声が耳に入ってきた。振りかえってみると……あれ、吉川さんじゃないか。
lines.english: Just as I began to sink, a familiar voice reached me. I turned around and... Oh, it was Yoshikawa.

lines.japanese: 「いま帰るところですか？」
lines.english: “Are you on your way home?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うんそう。吉川さんも？」
lines.english: “Yeah. Are you?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。私もこっちなんで」
lines.english: “Yes. I live this way too.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ途中まで一緒に帰ろう」
lines.english: “Then let’s walk together part of the way.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あ、ああっ。は、はい」
lines.english: “What? Oh! Y-yes.”

lines.japanese: よかった、話相手がいればがっかり感もちょっとは薄れるだろう。
lines.english: Good. Someone to talk to would soften the disappointment.

lines.japanese: 吉川さんは半歩ほど俺の後ろに立って、俯きがちに付いてきた。
lines.english: Yoshikawa walked half a step behind me with her head lowered.

lines.japanese: ふむ、さすがは俺の妹が親友に選んだだけのことはある。慎ましやかな空気に好感が持てるじゃないか。小鳩がいなければ妹にしてしまいたい。
lines.english: Hmm. My sister had chosen her best friend well. Her modest air was quite charming. If I hadn't already had Kobato, I would have wanted her as my little sister.

lines.japanese: 彼女が口数の少ない子だというのは分かっていた。ならば、こちらから話題を振ってあげなければ。
lines.english: I knew she wasn't talkative. That meant I had to give her something to talk about.

lines.japanese: 「吉川さんはこんな時間まで何してたの？」
lines.english: “What were you doing out this late, Yoshikawa?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、えっと買い物です。ちょっと毛糸と編み物の針を……」
lines.english: “Oh, um, shopping. I bought some yarn and knitting needles...”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、編み物」
lines.english: “Knitting, huh?”

lines.japanese: そりゃまた似合いすぎる趣味だなあ。日曜日に部屋で編み物をする吉川さん。うん、絵になるな。
lines.english: That hobby suited her almost too perfectly. Yoshikawa knitting in her room on a Sunday. Yes. What a picture.

lines.japanese: 「今までやったことないんですけど」
lines.english: “I've never done it before, though.”

lines.japanese: 「ないのかよ」
lines.english: “You haven't?”

lines.japanese: 「その、これから始めようと思って。お裁縫とかも出来た方がいいのかなって……」
lines.english: “Um, I thought I'd start now. I was thinking I should learn to sew and things like that too...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それは素晴らしい発想だなあ。今日び、そういう女の子らしい趣味を持ってる子は、国際的に保護してあげないとね」
lines.english: “Ah, what a splendid idea. These days, girls with traditionally feminine hobbies like that ought to receive international protection.”

lines.japanese: 「そっ、そうですか。私、がんばります」
lines.english: “R-really? I'll do my best.”

lines.japanese: 日野英里子も言ってたけど、学名、羽田目小鳩科吉川属は絶滅の危機に瀕しているからな。いま目の前にいる吉川あきら種が最後の一人だ。
lines.english: Eriko Hino had said it herself: the scientific order Haneda, family Kobato, genus Yoshikawa was endangered. The Akira Yoshikawa before me was the last of her species.

lines.japanese: 「偉いなあ。うちの小鳩にも吉川さんを見習わせないとなあ」
lines.english: “How admirable. I'll have to make our Kobato follow your example.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　いえ、逆ですよ？」
lines.english: “What? No, it's the other way around.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ！　うちの小鳩が偉くないだと！」
lines.english: “What?! Are you saying our Kobato isn't admirable?!”

lines.japanese: 「わっ！　ちち、違います」
lines.english: “Ah! N-no, that's not what I meant.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、今回は私が羽田さんを見習った側で」
lines.english: “This time, I was the one following Haneda's example.”

lines.japanese: 「小鳩を？　それはどういうわけで？」
lines.english: “Kobato's? Why is that?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はいそれは……」
lines.english: “Well, um...”

lines.japanese: 吉川さんは買い物袋を見つめつつ、数時間前のことを思いだすように話しはじめた。
lines.english: Yoshikawa looked down at her shopping bag and began recounting something from a few hours earlier.

lines.japanese: 「今日、家庭科の授業があって、手芸だったんです。今日はブラウスを途中まで縫ったんですけど……」
lines.english: “We had home economics today, and the lesson was handicrafts. We sewed part of a blouse...”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、家庭科……俺たち男子には、もう懐かしい響きだなあ」
lines.english: “Home economics... That has a nostalgic ring to us boys.”

lines.japanese: 「その家庭科で、羽田さんのまつり縫いがすごく上手だったから、先生に褒められてたんです」
lines.english: “Haneda's blind stitch was so good that the teacher praised her.”

lines.japanese: 「なにっ！」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が学校で褒められていただって！？
lines.english: Kobato had been praised at school?!

lines.japanese: 「冬休み前にやってた洗濯の授業でも褒められてたし……羽田さんは大したことないって言うんですけど、私なんて洗濯もしたことないから、ぜんぜん使い方が分からなくて」
lines.english: “She was praised during our laundry lesson before winter break too... Haneda says it's nothing special, but I've never even done laundry, so I had no idea how to use anything.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田さんはちゃんと家事のお手伝いしてるみたいだから、私も何かしようかなーって思うんです」
lines.english: “She clearly helps with the housework, so I thought maybe I should start doing something too.”

lines.japanese: そんな出来事があったのか……予め家庭科の授業があることを知っていれば、忍びこんででも見学へ行ったのに。
lines.english: So that had happened... If only I'd known about the home-economics class in advance. I would have snuck into the school to watch.

lines.japanese: 「それで、ブラウスが終わったら次は編み物らしいので、その練習をしようかなって……あっ、あれ？　お兄さん？」
lines.english: “Apparently we'll start knitting once the blouse is finished, so I thought I'd practice... Um, huh? Big Brother?”

lines.japanese: 吉川さんの声に気付いてみれば、いつの間にか俺は彼女から三歩も遅れていた。
lines.english: Yoshikawa's voice brought me back to myself. Somehow, I had fallen three steps behind her.

lines.japanese: ふうむ……小鳩の優秀さが分かるとは、なかなか見所のある教員だ。今すぐ菓子折りを持ってお礼に参上したいが、それよりもまずここは小鳩をこそ絶賛するべきだろう。
lines.english: Hmm... Any teacher capable of recognizing Kobato's excellence had a good eye. I wanted to present them with a box of sweets immediately, but first and foremost, Kobato herself deserved my praise.

lines.japanese: 家庭科の授業で褒められたなんて、すなわち良妻賢母と認められたも同義じゃないか。いますぐ婚姻届を取りに行きたい。
lines.english: Being praised in home economics was tantamount to official recognition as a good wife and wise mother. I wanted to fetch a marriage-registration form that instant.

lines.japanese: 「あの、お兄さん……？」
lines.english: “Um, Big Brother...?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いやいやごめん。小鳩の学校での様子なんて分からないから、褒められてるって聞いたら嬉しくて。安心したよ、ありがとう吉川さん」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. I never get to see Kobato at school, so hearing that she earned praise made me happy. That's a relief. Thank you, Yoshikawa.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そうですか？　えへへ、それはよかったです」
lines.english: “Oh, really? Heehee. I'm glad.”

lines.japanese: 「それで吉川さんは何を編むの？　練習するんだよね」
lines.english: “What are you going to knit, Yoshikawa? You said you wanted to practice.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、私は来月の１４日までにマフラーを……って、わわっ。あ、あの、私ここでいつも羽田さんとお別れでした。道、こっちなんです」
lines.english: “Oh, I want to make a scarf by the fourteenth of next month... W-wait! Um, this is where Haneda and I always part ways. I go this way.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか、も少し話したかったけど仕方ないな。じゃあね、また遊びに来てよ」
lines.english: “I see. I wanted to talk a little longer, but it can't be helped. See you. Come visit us again.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はいっ。私こそ楽しかったです。ありがとうございました」
lines.english: “Y-yes! I had fun too. Thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: あ、もう遅いし、家まで送ってあげればよかったかな……と思ったものの、気付いたときにはもう夜の闇に消えていた。
lines.english: Oh. It was late, so perhaps I should have walked her home... but by the time the thought occurred to me, she had vanished into the darkness.

lines.japanese: でも、そっかあ……小鳩のやつ、口ベタだし本番に弱いトコあるし、学校で上手くやってるか心配してたけど、先生に褒められたりしてるのか。
lines.english: Still, imagine that... Kobato wasn’t good with words, and she tended to stumble when it counted, so I’d worried about how she was doing at school. But her teachers were praising her.

lines.japanese: へへっ、さすがうちの妹だ。帰ったら、嫌がって逃げだすぐらいたっぷりと頭を撫でてあげよう。
lines.english: Heh heh. That's my little sister. When I got home, I would stroke her head until she fled in protest.

lines.japanese: 家までの道のり、俺の脚はさながらゴムの上でも歩いているように弾んだ。
lines.english: My feet bounced all the way home as though I were walking on rubber.

lines.japanese: 「たっだいまあ～ん！」
lines.english: “I'm hooome!”

lines.japanese: 空気のように軽いドアを開くと、小さな靴が踵を後ろ向きにして揃っていた。
lines.english: I opened the door, light as air, and found a little pair of shoes neatly lined up with the heels toward me.

lines.japanese: 家の明かりも点いてるし、小鳩は先に帰ってるみたいだ。叔父さんと叔母さんの靴はない。
lines.english: The lights were on, so Kobato must have arrived first. My aunt and uncle's shoes were absent.

lines.japanese: てことは合法的に二人っきりじゃないか。ようし、今日は吉川さんから聞いた話をネタに、いっぱい褒めてあげよう。
lines.english: That meant the two of us were legally alone together! Excellent. Today I would use Yoshikawa's story as an excuse to shower her with praise.

lines.japanese: あんまり小鳩にデレデレしないという目標はあったが、今日だけ特別だ。今すぐ妹の顔を見たい。
lines.english: I had resolved not to fawn over Kobato so much, but today was special. I wanted to see my sister's face immediately.

lines.japanese: 部屋かなあ～？　居間かなあ～ん？　俺はまず目の前にあった襖をからりと開いた。
lines.english: Was she in her room? The living room? I slid open the nearest door.

lines.japanese: そこには天使の寝息が揺蕩っていた。
lines.english: Inside floated an angel's gentle breathing.

lines.japanese: 今日は金曜日。ここしばらく、叔母さんがいるにも関わらず、小鳩は積極的に家事を手伝っていた。学校と家事との両立で、さぞかしお疲れのことだろう。
lines.english: It was Friday. For some time now, Kobato had eagerly helped with the chores even when our aunt was home. Balancing school and housework must have exhausted her.

lines.japanese: 「うう小鳩、いつもありがとう……お兄ちゃん何もしなくてごめんな……んっ？」
lines.english: “Oh, Kobato. Thank you for everything... I'm sorry Big Brother never does anyth—hm?”

lines.japanese: 机の上に可愛らしい裁縫セットが置かれている。これは叔母さんのじゃなくて、小鳩の？
lines.english: A cute little sewing kit sat on the table. It wasn't my aunt's. Was it Kobato's?

lines.japanese: そしてその脇には、皺を伸ばして綺麗に畳まれた白いスラックス。
lines.english: Beside it lay a pair of white slacks, smoothed out and neatly folded.

lines.japanese: 「俺の？」
lines.english: “Mine?”

lines.japanese: 広げてみると、やっぱり俺の制服だ。おとといの朝ズボンを穿こうとしたときに破れたファスナーが、綺麗に補修されていた。
lines.english: I unfolded them. They were my uniform pants. The zipper I had broken while getting dressed the morning before last had been beautifully repaired.

lines.japanese: 「え、これ……小鳩が？」
lines.english: “Did Kobato... do this?”

lines.japanese: お、俺の知らないうちに直してくれたのか……。
lines.english: Sh-she had repaired them without telling me...

lines.japanese: “その家庭科で、羽田さんのまつり縫いがすごく上手だったから、先生にほめられてたんです”
lines.english: “Haneda's blind stitch was so good that the teacher praised her.”

lines.japanese: ファスナーの部分を裏返してみると、丁寧で細やかなまつり縫いが施されていた。
lines.english: I turned the zipper section inside out and found a line of careful, delicate blind stitches.

lines.japanese: ま、まるで業者にお願いしたみたいに綺麗じゃないか。
lines.english: I-it looked as perfect as if I'd paid a professional.

lines.japanese: 改めて見降ろした小鳩の寝顔は、普段よりいっそう美しく輝いていた。
lines.english: I looked down at Kobato again. Her sleeping face shone more beautifully than ever.

lines.japanese: 奉仕精神に満ちたその無垢な姿は、俺の発声器官を感動で埋めつくし、言葉を透明なものに変えてしまった。ああ、いま声を出したら、俺は跪いて号泣するかもしれない。
lines.english: Her innocent form, brimming with selfless devotion, filled my organs of speech with emotion and rendered words transparent. If I made a sound now, I might fall to my knees and sob.

lines.japanese: ああ、女神よ。
lines.english: Ah, goddess.

lines.japanese: いまもしこの大いなる情動を文章・口述・造形いずれかで表せたなら、おそらく俺は人類史上最高の芸術家になるだろう。
lines.english: If I could express this vast emotion through writing, speech, or sculpture, I would surely become the greatest artist in human history.

lines.japanese: 「神々しい……おお、神よ……偉大なる女神よ……」
lines.english: “Divine... Oh, God... Great goddess...”

lines.japanese: 気づけば俺は賛美歌の中で祈っていた。
lines.english: Before I knew it, I was praying in a hymn.

lines.japanese: 「ん、んんっ……」

lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 純白の天使兼俺のプリンセスが、寒そうに肩を震わせている！
lines.english: My pure-white angel and personal princess shivered with cold!

lines.japanese: よく見れば、冬だと言うのに毛布が腰までしか掛かってないじゃないか。
lines.english: Looking closer, I saw that despite the winter chill, her blanket reached only to her waist.

lines.japanese: 俺は涙を拭いさり、小鳩の毛布をそっとつまんだ。肩まで被せてあげなければ。
lines.english: I wiped away my tears and gently pinched the edge of Kobato's blanket. I had to pull it up to her shoulders.

lines.japanese: いつもありがとう、俺の大好きなひと。毛布を掛ける程度のことしかしてやれないお兄ちゃんでごめんな。
lines.english: Thank you for everything, my beloved. Forgive a big brother who could do no more for you than pull up a blanket.

lines.japanese: よっこいせ。
lines.english: Heave-ho.

lines.japanese: 俺、シスコンとかロリコンとかそういうの全然ないけどね。
lines.english: I didn't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything, of course.

lines.japanese: そう自分に言い訳しないと、冷静じゃいられない場面だった。
lines.english: It was a scene in which I needed that excuse to remain calm.

lines.japanese: 毛布の中で元からそうなっていたのか、剥がした拍子に引っかかったのか、小鳩のスカートがめくれちゃいけない部分までめくれ上がっていた。
lines.english: Either it had already been that way beneath the blanket, or the fabric had caught when I pulled, but Kobato's skirt had ridden up much farther than it should have.

lines.japanese: あ、あわわわ、なんてコトしてもうたんだ……ちちち違うんだ、もちろんわざとじゃないよ！？　わざとじゃないんだけど……！
lines.english: A-awa-wa-wa! What had I done...? Th-th-this was a mistake! Obviously I hadn't done it on purpose! I hadn't, but...!

lines.japanese: そして俺が動転のあまり硬直している間に、小鳩が目覚めてしまった。
lines.english: While I stood frozen in panic, Kobato woke up.

lines.japanese: まるで俺が毛布と共に、小鳩のスカートをめくったかのような光景だった。
lines.english: The scene made it look as though I had lifted Kobato's skirt along with the blanket.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん？　帰ってたんだ、おかえりー」
lines.english: “Big Brother? You're home. Welcome back.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ。ただいま、小鳩」
lines.english: “Y-yeah. I'm home, Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、こんなところで居眠りなんてしちゃって。駄目だぞ？」
lines.english: “Hahaha. Falling asleep in a place like this? You shouldn't do that.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん。ごめんなさい」
lines.english: “O-okay. Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ疲れてるだろうから仕方ないけどな。毛布はきちんと肩まで掛けないと、風邪ひいちゃうからな」
lines.english: “Well, you're tired, so it can't be helped. But you need to pull the blanket all the way up to your shoulders or you'll catch cold.”

lines.japanese: 俺はあらぬ疑惑を持たれる前に過失を揉みけそうとした。
lines.english: Before any improper suspicion could arise, I tried to bury my offense beneath a lesser negligence.

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん。なんか部屋が寒いもんね……」
lines.english: “Oh, okay. The room does feel kind of cold...”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　足元さむい？」
lines.english: “Hm? Why are my legs cold?”

lines.japanese: しかし一瞬遅かった。小鳩は自らの異変に、視覚で気付いてしまった。
lines.english: But I was one instant too late. Kobato saw what had happened to her.

lines.japanese: 「いやっ、違うぞ小鳩！　これはな、順序が逆なんだ。お兄ちゃんは決してめくろうとしたんじゃなく、掛けようとして――」
lines.english: “N-no, Kobato! You've got it backward. Big Brother wasn't trying to lift anything. I was trying to cover you—”

lines.japanese: 「は、早く出てって」
lines.english: “P-please leave.”

lines.japanese: 「いやっ！　もちろんそうするべきなんだが、俺はどうしても小鳩にお礼がしたくて……そうだ、肩までかけてあげよう。それから出ていくから、なっ？」
lines.english: “Of course I should! But I absolutely have to thank you... Right, I'll pull the blanket up to your shoulders, then I'll leave. Okay?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いいからもう出てって！」
lines.english: “J-just get out!”

lines.japanese: 「なっ！　それは駄目だぞ小鳩。だってせっかくズボンを直してもらっといて、お礼もせずに立ちさるなんて真似は――」
lines.english: “N-no! I can't do that, Kobato. You went to the trouble of repairing my pants. I can't just walk away without even thanking you—”

lines.japanese: 「ふええええええん！」
lines.english: “WAAAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 「うわあああ、泣くな小鳩！　ごっ、ごめなさああああい！」
lines.english: “WAAAH! Don't cry, Kobato! I-I'm sooorry!”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の体に毛布を放りなげるや、一気に階段を駆けあがった。
lines.english: I flung the blanket over Kobato and raced upstairs in one burst.

lines.japanese: そして自分の部屋へ入ると、頭から布団をかぶった。
lines.english: The moment I entered my room, I pulled the futon over my head.

lines.japanese: 「ふうーっ！　ふううぅーっ！」
lines.english: “Huff! Huuuff!”

lines.japanese: 逆巻く情動のうねりに抗うため、俺は死に物狂いで呪文を唱えた。
lines.english: To resist the raging tide of emotion, I desperately recited an incantation.

lines.japanese: 「俺シスコンとかロリコンとかないけどね！　俺シスコンとかロリコンとかないけどね！」
lines.english: “I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex! I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex!”

lines.japanese: ふう……ふう……。
lines.english: Huff... Huff...

lines.japanese: じいちゃん……俺やったよ。自分の中の獣を追いかえしてやったよ。
lines.english: Grandpa... I did it. I drove the beast inside me away.

lines.japanese: 俺はぐったりとして、そのまま夕飯の時間までもりもり眠りこけた。
lines.english: I collapsed and slept like the dead until dinner.
